name: explain-it-better
description: A standalone skill that turns rough requests into confirmation-gated briefs before work begins.

interface.shortDescription: Turn a rough request into a clear, approved brief.
interface.longDescription: Explain It Better is a self-contained planning skill. It turns a rough request into a clear brief, makes assumptions visible, and waits for approval before the agent starts the work.
defaultPrompt: Use Explain It Better to prepare my request before work begins.
Turn this rough idea into a clear brief and show me the assumptions.
Scope this project request, then wait for my approval.
